source_text: Design a small storage box with a hinged lid. The lid should stay closed until the user releases it with a thumb. The box should be safe to use, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture.
product_intent: A small, desktop-sized storage box with a hinged lid that remains closed until intentionally opened by thumb pressure, designed for safe use, easy assembly, and practical manufacture through additive manufacturing.
user_intent_summary: Design a small, desktop-sized storage box with a hinged lid that stays closed until released by thumb pressure, using additive manufacturing, and ensuring safety, ease of assembly, and practical manufacture.

clauses.text: Design a small storage box with a hinged lid
The lid should stay closed until the user releases it with a thumb
The box should be safe to use

requirements.statement: The storage box must have a hinged lid that remains closed until intentionally released by thumb pressure

verification.observable: Lid remains closed when not pressed and opens when thumb pressure is applied

requirements.statement: The storage box must be safe to use

verification.observable: No sharp edges, toxic materials, or hazardous components

requirements.statement: The storage box must be easy to assemble

verification.observable: Assembly can be completed with minimal tools and time

requirements.statement: The storage box must be practical to manufacture

verification.observable: Design allows for efficient production using additive manufacturing techniques

requirements.statement: The storage box must be desktop-sized

verification.observable: Dimensions conform to desktop-sized product requirements

requirements.statement: The storage box must operate manually only

verification.observable: Operation requires no external power source or mechanical assistance

requirements.statement: The storage box must be designed for additive manufacturing

verification.observable: Design features compatible with additive manufacturing processes

operating_scenarios.description: User holds box with lid closed, applies thumb pressure to open lid

operating_scenarios.description: Box is produced using additive manufacturing techniques while maintaining safety and assembly requirements

operating_scenarios.name: Safe Use Environment
operating_scenarios.description: Box is used in typical desktop environment with no hazardous conditions
